info.title: IMPROJ API
info.description: The IMPROJ public REST API. JSON only. Authenticate with a personal access token (improj_pat_...) or an organisation token (improj_org_...) in the Authorization header as a Bearer token. Every request acts as the token's owner with exactly the permissions the owner has in the app, narrowed by the token's scopes and limits. Rate limits per minute: 300 requests and 60 writes per token, 600 per client address. Errors are RFC 7807 application/problem+json with a stable code. Lists are cursor paginated.

bearerAuth.description: Scopes: user:read (Your profile), projects:read (Projects), tasks:read (Read tasks), tasks:write (Write tasks), milestones:read (Read milestones), milestones:write (Write milestones), members:read (Members), files:read (Read files), files:write (Upload files), calendar:read (Read calendar), calendar:write (Write calendar), meetings:read (Meetings), webhooks:manage (Webhooks), agent:read (AI agents: read), agent:note (AI agents: note)

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a POST safe to retry for 24 hours: the same key with the same request returns the first answer.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-Request-Id.description: Quote it when you contact support.

email.description: Shown only when the person lets other members see it (the app's email privacy setting).

time_zone.description: IANA zone of the wall clock times (null: floating local time).

recurrence.description: RFC 5545 RRULE of a repeating event.

url.description: Shown masked: host and the start of the path.

id.description: evt_<number>, stable across retries of the same event.

user:read.title: Your profile
user:read.description: Read your own name, time zone and language (GET /me).

projects:read.title: Projects
projects:read.description: List and read the projects you can open, with their work packages and activities.

tasks:read.description: Read the tasks you can see in your projects.

members:read.description: Read project members. Email addresses follow each person's privacy setting.

files:read.title: Read files

meetings:read.title: Meetings
